title: New widget: RangeInput
body: In react-instantsearch, there is a [RangeInput widget](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/widgets/RangeInput.html) to be able to set a range with two inputs. We can implement with connectRangeSlider. In the process, we should probably alias connectRangeSlider to connectRange and deprecate connectRangeSlider.
